---
name: build-and-test
description: Create the npm build system (TypeScript + esbuild + Node SEA executable), the add() test function and Vitest unit tests, then run them. Use from the create-build command.
---

# Skill: build-and-test

## When to use
- After `project-scaffold` succeeded (`src/hello.ts` exists), or
- the user runs `/create-build`, or the `init` orchestrator reaches step 3.

The skill is split into sub-steps that can be run separately:
`build-config` → `unit-tests` → `packaging` → `run`.

## Inputs
| Input | Default | Description |
|-------|---------|-------------|
| `projectName` | `hello-world` | `package.json` `name` |
| `nodeVersion` | `22` | Minimal Node.js version (`engines.node`) |
| `testName` | `BasicAddition` | Name of the required unit test |

Precondition: Node.js >= 22 and npm are installed (`node --version`).

## Outputs
| File | Purpose |
|------|---------|
| `package.json` | npm scripts `typecheck`, `build`, `start`, `test`, `package`, `check`, `clean` and devDependencies |
| `package-lock.json` | Generated by `npm install`; committed for reproducible `npm ci` |
| `tsconfig.json` | Strict TypeScript config, type-checks `src/` and `tests/` |
| `vitest.config.ts` | Vitest config, verbose reporter |
| `tests/math.test.ts` | Unit test `BasicAddition` for `add()` |
| `tests/greeting.test.ts` | Tests `DefaultGreeting`, `NamedGreeting` |
| `scripts/package.mjs` | Builds the standalone executable `bin/hello` / `bin/hello.exe` (Node SEA) |
| `scripts/clean.mjs` | Removes only git-ignored build output |
| `scripts/check.mjs` | Read-only verification used by `/check` |
| Build output (ignored) | `dist/hello.js`, `build/sea-prep.blob`, `bin/hello[.exe]` |

## Steps
1. **build-config**: create `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `vitest.config.ts`
   from the templates. If `package.json` exists, merge: add only missing
   scripts/devDependencies, never duplicate keys.
2. Run `npm install` (creates `package-lock.json`). Note: Vitest 4 fails with
   npm 10.9 (`Cannot read properties of null (reading 'edgesOut')`), therefore
   Vitest `^3.2.4` is used.
3. **unit-tests**: create `tests/math.test.ts` and `tests/greeting.test.ts`.
4. **packaging**: create `scripts/package.mjs`, `scripts/clean.mjs`,
   `scripts/check.mjs` (copy of the template is the single source of truth
   for `/check`).
5. **run**: `npm run build`, `npm test`, `npm run package`, then run
   `./bin/hello` (`bin\hello.exe`).

## Templates
#### `package.json`
````json
{
  "name": "hello-world",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "description": "Cross-platform TypeScript Hello World (lab 1, variant 6) generated by the build-engineer AI agent",
  "private": true,
  "license": "MIT",
  "engines": {
    "node": ">=22"
  },
  "scripts": {
    "typecheck": "tsc --noEmit",
    "build": "npm run typecheck && esbuild src/hello.ts --bundle --platform=node --format=cjs --target=node22 --outfile=dist/hello.js",
    "start": "node dist/hello.js",
    "test": "vitest run",
    "package": "node scripts/package.mjs",
    "check": "node scripts/check.mjs",
    "clean": "node scripts/clean.mjs"
  },
  "devDependencies": {
    "@types/node": "^22.10.0",
    "esbuild": "^0.25.0",
    "postject": "1.0.0-alpha.6",
    "typescript": "~5.9.3",
    "vitest": "^3.2.4"
  }
}
````

#### `tsconfig.json`
````json
{
  "compilerOptions": {
    "target": "ES2022",
    "module": "CommonJS",
    "moduleResolution": "node",
    "rootDir": ".",
    "outDir": "dist",
    "strict": true,
    "esModuleInterop": true,
    "skipLibCheck": true,
    "forceConsistentCasingInFileNames": true,
    "types": ["node"]
  },
  "include": ["src/**/*.ts", "tests/**/*.ts"]
}
````

#### `vitest.config.ts`
````ts
import { defineConfig } from "vitest/config";

export default defineConfig({
  test: {
    include: ["tests/**/*.test.ts"],
    reporters: ["verbose"],
  },
});
````

#### `tests/math.test.ts`
````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { add } from "../src/math";

describe("math", () => {
  it("BasicAddition", () => {
    expect(add(2, 3)).toBe(5);
    expect(add(-1, 1)).toBe(0);
  });
});
````

#### `tests/greeting.test.ts`
````ts
import { describe, expect, it } from "vitest";
import { greeting } from "../src/greeting";

describe("greeting", () => {
  it("DefaultGreeting", () => {
    expect(greeting()).toBe("Hello, World!");
  });

  it("NamedGreeting", () => {
    expect(greeting("KI-407")).toBe("Hello, KI-407!");
  });
});
````

#### `scripts/package.mjs`
````js
// Packages dist/hello.js into a standalone executable bin/hello (bin/hello.exe on Windows)
// using Node.js Single Executable Applications (SEA). Works on Linux, macOS and Windows.
import { execFileSync } from "node:child_process";
import { copyFileSync, existsSync, mkdirSync, readFileSync, writeFileSync, chmodSync } from "node:fs";
import { createRequire } from "node:module";
import { join } from "node:path";

const require = createRequire(import.meta.url);
const { inject } = require("postject");

const isWin = process.platform === "win32";
const isMac = process.platform === "darwin";
const bundle = join("dist", "hello.js");
const buildDir = "build";
const binDir = "bin";
const blob = join(buildDir, "sea-prep.blob");
const exe = join(binDir, isWin ? "hello.exe" : "hello");

function step(msg) {
  console.log(`[package] ${msg}`);
}

if (!existsSync(bundle)) {
  console.error(`[package] ERROR: ${bundle} not found. Run "npm run build" first.`);
  process.exit(1);
}

mkdirSync(buildDir, { recursive: true });
mkdirSync(binDir, { recursive: true });

const seaConfig = join(buildDir, "sea-config.json");
writeFileSync(
  seaConfig,
  JSON.stringify({ main: bundle, output: blob, disableExperimentalSEAWarning: true }, null, 2),
);

step("generating SEA blob");
execFileSync(process.execPath, ["--experimental-sea-config", seaConfig], { stdio: "inherit" });

step(`copying node runtime to ${exe}`);
copyFileSync(process.execPath, exe);
if (!isWin) chmodSync(exe, 0o755);

if (isMac) {
  step("removing macOS signature");
  execFileSync("codesign", ["--remove-signature", exe], { stdio: "inherit" });
}

step("injecting application blob");
await inject(exe, "NODE_SEA_BLOB", readFileSync(blob), {
  sentinelFuse: "NODE_SEA_FUSE_fce680ab2cc467b6e072b8b5df1996b2",
  machoSegmentName: isMac ? "NODE_SEA" : undefined,
});

if (isMac) {
  step("ad-hoc signing for macOS");
  execFileSync("codesign", ["--sign", "-", exe], { stdio: "inherit" });
}

step(`verifying ${exe}`);
const out = execFileSync(exe, { encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
if (out !== "Hello, World!") {
  console.error(`[package] ERROR: unexpected output: "${out}"`);
  process.exit(1);
}
step(`OK: ${exe} prints "${out}"`);
````

#### `scripts/clean.mjs`
````js
// Removes git-ignored build output only (dist/, build/, bin/, coverage/).
import { rmSync } from "node:fs";

for (const dir of ["dist", "build", "bin", "coverage"]) {
  rmSync(dir, { recursive: true, force: true });
  console.log(`[clean] removed ${dir}/`);
}
````

#### `scripts/check.mjs`
````js
// Read-only verification used by the `check` command.
// It never modifies tracked files: it only reads them and runs build/tests,
// whose output goes to git-ignored directories (dist/, build/, bin/).
//
// Usage:
//   node scripts/check.mjs            full check (structure + build + tests)
//   node scripts/check.mjs --static   structure only (no build, no tests)
import { execSync } from "node:child_process";
import { existsSync, readFileSync } from "node:fs";

const staticOnly = process.argv.includes("--static");
const results = [];

function check(name, fn) {
  try {
    const detail = fn();
    if (detail === false) throw new Error("condition is false");
    results.push({ name, ok: true });
    console.log(`  PASS  ${name}`);
  } catch (err) {
    const message = String(err.message).split("\n")[0];
    results.push({ name, ok: false, error: message });
    console.log(`  FAIL  ${name}\n        -> ${message}`);
  }
}

function read(path) {
  if (!existsSync(path)) throw new Error(`missing file ${path}`);
  return readFileSync(path, "utf8");
}

function mustContain(path, needles) {
  const text = read(path);
  const missing = needles.filter((n) => !text.includes(n));
  if (missing.length) throw new Error(`${path} does not contain: ${missing.join(", ")}`);
}

const AGENT = ".github/agents/build-engineer.agent.md";
const SKILLS = ["project-scaffold", "build-and-test", "github-actions"];
const COMMANDS = ["git-init", "create-project", "create-build", "create-actions", "check", "init"];
const SKILL_SECTIONS = ["## When to use", "## Inputs", "## Outputs", "## Steps", "## Verification", "## Example", "## Typical errors"];
const COMMAND_SECTIONS = ["## Preconditions", "## Actions", "## Expected files", "## Verification", "## Error message"];

console.log("== Agent");
check("manifest exists", () => read(AGENT));
check("manifest has role, rules, forbidden actions, completion criteria", () =>
  mustContain(AGENT, ["## Role", "## Rules for working with files", "## Forbidden actions", "## Completion criteria"]),
);
for (const s of SKILLS) {
  check(`skill ${s} has purpose, inputs, outputs, verification`, () =>
    mustContain(`.github/skills/${s}/SKILL.md`, [`name: ${s}`, ...SKILL_SECTIONS]),
  );
}
for (const c of COMMANDS) {
  check(`command ${c} is defined`, () =>
    mustContain(`.github/prompts/${c}.prompt.md`, ["agent: build-engineer", "description:", ...COMMAND_SECTIONS]),
  );
}
check("init runs commands in the correct order", () => {
  const text = read(".github/prompts/init.prompt.md");
  const order = ["git-init", "create-project", "create-build", "create-actions", "check"].map((c) =>
    text.indexOf(`/${c}`),
  );
  if (order.some((i) => i < 0)) throw new Error("init does not reference all commands as /<command>");
  for (let i = 1; i < order.length; i++) {
    if (order[i] < order[i - 1]) throw new Error("commands are referenced out of order");
  }
});

console.log("== Project structure");
for (const f of [
  "README.md",
  ".gitignore",
  "package.json",
  "tsconfig.json",
  "vitest.config.ts",
  "src/hello.ts",
  "src/math.ts",
  "tests/math.test.ts",
  "scripts/ci.sh",
  "scripts/ci.bat",
  "scripts/package.mjs",
  "docs/architecture.md",
  "docs/usage.md",
  "docs/ai-log.md",
]) {
  check(`file ${f}`, () => read(f));
}
check("package.json has build/test/package/check scripts", () => {
  const pkg = JSON.parse(read("package.json"));
  const missing = ["build", "test", "package", "check"].filter((s) => !pkg.scripts?.[s]);
  if (missing.length) throw new Error(`missing scripts: ${missing.join(", ")}`);
});
check("test BasicAddition exists", () => mustContain("tests/math.test.ts", ['"BasicAddition"']));
check(".gitignore excludes build output and secrets", () =>
  mustContain(".gitignore", ["node_modules/", "dist/", "build/", "bin/", ".env"]),
);

console.log("== GitHub Actions workflow");
const WF = ".github/workflows/ci.yml";
check("workflow has push and pull_request triggers", () => mustContain(WF, ["push:", "pull_request:", "develop", "master"]));
check("workflow matrix has Windows, Linux and macOS", () =>
  mustContain(WF, ["matrix:", "ubuntu-latest", "windows-latest", "macos-latest"]),
);
check("workflow only calls CI scripts", () => mustContain(WF, ["scripts/ci.sh", "scripts\\ci.bat"]));
check("workflow has no secrets and does not hide failures", () => {
  const text = read(WF);
  for (const bad of ["secrets.", "continue-on-error: true", "|| true"]) {
    if (text.includes(bad)) throw new Error(`forbidden pattern "${bad}"`);
  }
});
check("workflow has exactly one job", () => {
  const text = read(WF);
  const jobs = text.split("\njobs:\n")[1] ?? "";
  const names = jobs.split("\n").filter((l) => /^  [A-Za-z0-9_-]+:\s*$/.test(l));
  if (names.length !== 1) throw new Error(`expected 1 job, found ${names.length}`);
});

console.log("== Git");
check("no build output or secrets tracked by git", () => {
  let files;
  try {
    files = execSync("git ls-files", { encoding: "utf8" }).split("\n");
  } catch {
    throw new Error("not a git repository");
  }
  const bad = files.filter((f) => /^(node_modules|dist|build|bin|coverage)\//.test(f) || /(^|\/)\.env/.test(f));
  if (bad.length) throw new Error(`tracked: ${bad.slice(0, 5).join(", ")}`);
});

if (!staticOnly) {
  console.log("== Build and tests");
  check("npm run build", () => execSync("npm run build", { stdio: "pipe" }));
  check("npm test (Vitest)", () => {
    const out = execSync("npm test", { encoding: "utf8", stdio: "pipe" });
    if (!out.includes("BasicAddition")) throw new Error("BasicAddition was not executed");
  });
  check("application prints Hello, World!", () => {
    const out = execSync("node dist/hello.js", { encoding: "utf8" }).trim();
    if (out !== "Hello, World!") throw new Error(`unexpected output "${out}"`);
  });
}

const failed = results.filter((r) => !r.ok);
console.log(`\n== Summary: ${results.length - failed.length}/${results.length} checks passed`);
if (failed.length) {
  console.log("CHECK FAILED:");
  for (const f of failed) console.log(`  - ${f.name}: ${f.error}`);
  process.exit(1);
}
console.log("CHECK PASSED");
````


## Verification
```bash
npm run build      # exit 0, creates dist/hello.js
npm test           # exit 0, output contains "BasicAddition"
npm run package    # exit 0, prints: [package] OK: bin/hello prints "Hello, World!"
./bin/hello        # Hello, World!
git status --short # dist/, build/, bin/, node_modules/ are NOT listed
```

## Example
Input: `projectName=hello-world`, `nodeVersion=22`, `testName=BasicAddition`  
Expected test output:
```text
 ✓ tests/greeting.test.ts > greeting > DefaultGreeting
 ✓ tests/greeting.test.ts > greeting > NamedGreeting
 ✓ tests/math.test.ts > math > BasicAddition
 Test Files  2 passed (2)
      Tests  3 passed (3)
```

## Typical errors
| Code | Situation | Action |
|------|-----------|--------|
| `E-BUILD-NODE` | `node --version` < 22 or missing | Stop; ask the user to install Node.js 22 LTS. |
| `E-BUILD-NPM-EDGES` | `npm install` → `reading 'edgesOut'` | Vitest 4 + npm 10.9 bug: use `vitest@^3.2.4`. |
| `E-BUILD-TSC` | `npm run typecheck` reports type errors | Show the errors, fix the source, rerun. Never add `// @ts-ignore` to hide them. |
| `E-TEST-FAIL` | `BasicAddition` fails (e.g. `add` returns `a - b`) | Report the assertion; fix `src/math.ts`, never the expected value in the test. |
| `E-PACKAGE-SEA` | `npm run package` cannot inject the blob (macOS signature) | Make sure `codesign --remove-signature` ran before `postject`. |
